SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-10-01 00:00:00'
                          THEN ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur ELSE 0 END)
       / SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur), 1)
FROM order_lines AS ol
JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
